recipes.name: Kerala Beef Fry
recipes.description: Coconut-oil dry-roasted beef with curry leaves and pepper.

steps.instruction: Pressure/slow cook beef with masala + salt.
Reduce on high till dry-roasted edges.
Temper mustard-shallot-coconut-curry leaf; toss through.

recipes.name: Beef Nihari
recipes.description: Overnight slow stew of shank in warm spices - Delhi dawn classic.

steps.instruction: Simmer meat+spices very low overnight (6-8h).
Ghee-flour roux whisked to velvet body.
Garnish heavy: ginger, chili, lemon, cilantro.

recipes.name: Anglo-Indian Beef Cutlets
recipes.description: Spiced minced-beef patties crumbed and shallow fried.

steps.instruction: Cook beef dry with aromatics/spices.
Mix potato; shape ovals; coat egg-crumb.
Shallow fry golden both sides.

recipes.name: Chettinad Pepper Beef
recipes.description: Fiery black-pepper star-anise beef stir fry.

steps.instruction: Sear beef batches hard.
Aromatics + spice bloom.
Combine; reduce glossy; pepper finish.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
recipes.description: Delhi's tandoori chicken in silky tomato-butter gravy.

steps.instruction: Char marinated chicken under broiler.
Simmer spiced tomato-cashew gravy 20 min; blend smooth.
Chicken in; butter + cream finish; methi crush.

videos.videoTitle: Original Indian Butter Chicken | Authentic & Creamy Recipe

recipes.name: Chicken 65
recipes.description: Chennai's fiery red fried chicken with curry-leaf tempering.

steps.instruction: Marinate 2h minimum.
Deep fry crisp at 175°C.
Curry-leaf-chili buttery toss.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Chicken 65: Indian Spiced Fried Chicken | Flavor Forward

recipes.name: Chettinad Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Roasted-spice coconut chicken curry from Tamil Nadu.

steps.instruction: Roast-grind masala fresh.
Sauté onion-tomato; chicken in; masala coat.
Water to gravy; simmer 25 min.

videos.videoTitle: Pepper Chicken Chettinad - Chicken Curry Recipe By Preetha - Chettinad Chicken Kulambu

recipes.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
recipes.description: Layered saffron basmati sealed and steamed over spiced chicken.

steps.instruction: Parboil spiced rice 70%.
Layer raw-marinated chicken + rice + herbs + saffron.
Seal pot; dum steam low 40 min; rest before opening.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Velvet spinach gravy with seared paneer cubes.

steps.instruction: Blanch shock-blend spinach (keep green).
Cook aromatics; spinach in 5 min only.
Paneer fold; cream swirl optional.

videos.videoTitle: Palak Paneer | All Time Favourite Recipe | Sanjeev Kapoor Khazana

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Tangy chickpea curry, pantry-hero status.

steps.instruction: Brown onion base well; spices bloom.
Chickpeas + water; simmer 20 min.
Amchur tang; ginger/cilantro top.

videos.videoTitle: Chana Masala Recipe | Dhaba Style Easy Chole | Chef Sanjyot Keer

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Black lentils slow-simmered overnight with butter and cream.

ingredients.name: Whole black urad dal + rajma few

steps.instruction: Simmer lentils 4h+ very low, stirring.
Tomato-ginger masala folded in mid-way.
Butter-cream finish; methi crush.

videos.videoTitle: Dal Makhani Recipe | Quick Indian Cooking

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Dry potato-cauliflower turmeric stir fry.

steps.instruction: Cumin seed tempering in oil.
Veg + spices; cover-steam 20 min stirring rarely.
Char edges; cilantro.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.description: Milk-dough spheres soaked in rose-cardamom syrup.

steps.instruction: Soft smooth dough; smooth crack-free balls.
Fry LOW ghee ~135°C till deep mahogany inside-cooked.
Warm syrup soak 2 hours minimum.

videos.videoTitle: Gulab Jamun Recipe | Tips for Soft & Perfect Gulab Jamun | परफेक्ट गुलाब जामुन | Chef Sanjyot Keer

recipes.name: Gajar ka Halwa
recipes.description: Slow-cooked carrot-condensed-milk pudding with nuts.

steps.instruction: Carrots simmered in milk till absorbed (~45 min).
Ghee fry till halwa glosses; sugar in.
Cardamom-nut crown.

recipes.name: Shami Kebab
recipes.description: Minced beef patties blended with chana dal and whole spices then pan-seared to a golden crust

steps.instruction: Boil beef mince with chana dal ginger garlic and whole spices until the lentils are completely tender
Grind the mixture into a smooth paste then fold in chopped onions herbs and beaten egg until well combined
Shape into oval patties and cook on a flat griddle with ghee until golden brown and crisp on both sides

recipes.name: Kheema Matar
recipes.description: Spiced minced beef simmered with green peas and aromatic whole spices

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a pan and sauté cumin seeds onions and ginger-garlic paste until the onions turn golden
Add tomatoes turmeric and coriander powder then cook until the tomatoes break down into a thick masala
Stir in the beef mince and cook until browned then add green peas and a splash of water and simmer until the peas are tender

recipes.name: Beef Chili Masala
recipes.description: Goan-style spicy beef tossed with fiery chilies and tangy vinegar

steps.instruction: Marinate beef strips with turmeric chili powder and vinegar for twenty minutes
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry ginger garlic and sliced chilies until fragrant then add onions and cook until softened
Toss in the marinated beef and cook on high heat until seared then add tomatoes and cook until the sauce clings to the meat

recipes.name: Kerala Beef Curry
recipes.description: Coconut-based beef curry from Kerala with curry leaves and roasted spices

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes in hot coconut oil with curry leaves then set aside
Sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices in the same pot until the masala is fragrant and oil separates
Return the beef add tomatoes and half the coconut milk then simmer covered until the beef is tender and finish with the remaining coconut milk

recipes.name: Beef Ularthiyathu
recipes.description: Dry-roasted Kerala beef with coconut slices curry leaves and freshly cracked pepper

steps.instruction: Cook beef with turmeric and salt until tender then drain and shred into bite-size pieces
Heat coconut oil and fry coconut slices shallots ginger garlic and curry leaves until the coconut turns golden
Toss in the cooked beef pepper and coriander powder then roast on high heat until the edges are crisp and deeply caramelized

recipes.name: Mangalorean Beef Curry
recipes.description: Rich coastal curry from Mangalore with roasted spice paste and tamarind

steps.instruction: Dry-roast coriander seeds and red chilies then grind into a fine paste with tamarind and a little water
Brown beef in coconut oil with curry leaves then add onions ginger-garlic paste and cook until golden
Stir in the roasted spice paste and tomatoes then add water and simmer covered until the beef is tender and the gravy is thick

recipes.name: Mughlai Beef Curry
recipes.description: Creamy Mughlai-style curry with cashew paste saffron and warm whole spices

steps.instruction: Fry onions in ghee until deeply golden then grind with cashew paste into a smooth base
Sear beef in the same pot with ginger-garlic paste then add the onion-cashew paste yogurt and saffron and cook until oil separates
Add tomatoes and a cup of water then simmer covered until the beef is tender and finish with cream and garam masala

recipes.name: Beef Jalfrezi
recipes.description: Tender beef strips stir-fried with bell peppers onions and aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wok and sear beef strips on high heat until browned then remove and set aside
Stir-fry onions bell peppers and green chilies until slightly charred then add ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices
Return the beef add chopped tomatoes and cook on high heat for a few minutes until the sauce coats the vegetables and meat

recipes.name: Beef Bhuna
recipes.description: Slow-cooked spiced beef in a thick concentrated masala with caramelized onions

steps.instruction: Cook onions in oil over medium heat until deeply caramelized and golden brown
Add ginger-garlic paste cumin seeds and all powdered spices then cook until the oil separates from the masala
Stir in beef and tomatoes then cook covered on low heat until the beef is very tender and the sauce is thick and clinging

recipes.name: Beef Masala
recipes.description: Classic North Indian beef curry with a robust onion-tomato masala and warm spices

steps.instruction: Heat oil and brown cumin seeds then sauté onions until golden and add ginger-garlic paste
Add tomatoes turmeric coriander and chili powder then cook until the masala is thick and oil separates
Add beef cubes and cook until seared on all sides then add water and simmer covered until the beef is fork tender

recipes.name: Chapli Kebab
recipes.description: Peshawari-style spiced beef patties with crushed coriander seeds and pomegranate

steps.instruction: Mix beef mince with finely chopped onions tomatoes green chilies coriander and crushed coriander seeds
Add beaten egg corn flour pomegranate seeds and salt then knead until the mixture is sticky and well combined
Shape into large flat patties and cook on a hot griddle with oil pressing gently until a dark crust forms on each side

recipes.name: Beef Kali Mirch
recipes.description: Bold black pepper beef curry with a sharp peppery sauce and cumin undertones

steps.instruction: Coarsely crush black peppercorns and dry-roast with cumin seeds until fragrant then set aside
Brown beef in ghee then add onions ginger-garlic paste and cook until the onions are deeply golden
Stir in the roasted pepper blend yogurt and tomatoes then simmer covered until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick and peppery

recipes.name: Beef Musallam
recipes.description: Whole slow-roasted spiced beef leg marinated in yogurt and Mughlai spices

steps.instruction: Marinate beef leg with yogurt ginger-garlic paste turmeric garam masala and saffron for at least one hour
Sear the marinated beef in hot ghee on all sides until evenly browned then transfer to a deep roasting pot
Cover with fried onion and cashew paste mixture add a splash of water and cook covered on low heat until the beef is very tender then finish with cream

recipes.name: Beef Dhansak
recipes.description: Parsi specialty of beef and lentils cooked together with mustard seeds and warm spices

steps.instruction: Wash and soak both dals then cook with turmeric until completely soft and mushy
Heat oil and pop mustard seeds then sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and dhansak masala until fragrant
Add beef and tomatoes and cook until browned then add the cooked dals and simmer together until the beef is tender and the stew is thick

recipes.name: Kadai Beef
recipes.description: Wok-cooked beef in a bold tomato gravy with crushed coriander and dried red chilies

steps.instruction: Dry-roast crushed coriander seeds and cumin seeds until fragrant then set aside
Heat oil in a kadai and sear beef strips on high heat until browned then add ginger-garlic paste and dried red chilies
Add onions bell peppers tomatoes and the roasted spices then cook on high heat until the vegetables are tender-crisp and the sauce is thick

recipes.name: Chicken Chettinad
recipes.description: Bold and aromatic Tamil Nadu curry with freshly ground spices and fennel

steps.instruction: Dry-roast fennel seeds black pepper red chilies and coconut then grind into a coarse Chettinad spice paste
Heat oil and sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves until golden then add tomatoes and cook until soft
Add chicken and the ground spice paste then stir well and cook covered until the chicken is tender and the masala clings to each piece

recipes.name: Malabar Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Coconut-rich coastal curry from the Malabar region with kodampuli and curry leaves

steps.instruction: Soak kodampuli in warm water for fifteen minutes then set aside
Heat coconut oil and sauté onions ginger-garlic paste curry leaves and all powdered spices until the masala is fragrant
Add chicken and sear until the outside is sealed then add tomatoes kodampuli and coconut milk and simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through

recipes.name: Mughlai Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Rich and velvety curry with cashew-saffron paste and fragrant garam masala

steps.instruction: Fry onions in ghee until deeply golden then blend with cashew paste into a smooth rich base
Sear chicken in ghee with ginger-garlic paste then add the onion-cashew base yogurt and saffron and cook until oil separates
Simmer covered until the chicken is tender then stir in cream garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander

recipes.name: Chicken Jalfrezi
recipes.description: Vibrant stir-fried chicken with crisp bell peppers onions and a tangy tomato sauce

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wok and sear chicken pieces on high heat until lightly browned then remove and set aside
Stir-fry onions bell peppers and green chilies until slightly charred then add ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices
Return the chicken add chopped tomatoes and cook on high heat for a few minutes until the sauce coats everything in a glossy glaze

recipes.name: Chicken Bhuna
recipes.description: Concentrated chicken curry cooked down in a thick spiced onion-tomato masala

steps.instruction: Cook onions in oil over medium heat until deeply caramelized and reduced to a jammy consistency
Add ginger-garlic paste cumin seeds and all powdered spices then cook until the oil separates from the masala
Stir in chicken and tomatoes then cook covered on low heat until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick and clinging to the meat

recipes.name: Chicken Dhansak
recipes.description: Parsi chicken and lentil curry simmered together with mustard seeds and warm spices

steps.instruction: Wash and soak both dals then cook with turmeric until completely soft and mushy
Heat oil and pop mustard seeds then sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and dhansak masala until fragrant
Add chicken and tomatoes and cook until browned then stir in the cooked dals and simmer until the chicken is tender and the stew is thick

recipes.name: Chicken Madras
recipes.description: South Indian hot and tangy chicken curry with tamarind and a fiery chili base

steps.instruction: Heat oil and lightly toast fenugreek seeds then sauté onions until golden and add ginger-garlic paste
Add tomatoes chili powder coriander powder and turmeric then cook until the masala is thick and the oil separates
Stir in chicken and tamarind paste then add water and simmer covered until the chicken is tender and the gravy is fiery and tangy

recipes.name: Kerala Chicken Roast
recipes.description: Slow-roasted Kerala-style chicken in a thick masala with curry leaves and shallots

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with turmeric chili powder and salt for twenty minutes then sear in coconut oil until golden
Sauté sliced shallots ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves in the same pan until the shallots are deeply caramelized
Add tomatoes coriander powder and fennel powder then return the chicken and cook covered on low until the masala is thick and the chicken is tender

recipes.name: Chicken Kadai
recipes.description: Wok-tossed chicken in a robust tomato gravy with crushed coriander and dried chilies

steps.instruction: Dry-roast crushed coriander seeds and cumin seeds until fragrant then set aside
Heat oil in a kadai and brown chicken pieces then add ginger-garlic paste dried red chilies and sliced onions
Add tomatoes bell peppers and the roasted spices then cook on high heat until the vegetables are tender-crisp and the sauce clings to the chicken

recipes.name: Chicken Rara
recipes.description: Unique Punjabi curry combining minced and bone-in chicken in a rich spiced gravy

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté cumin seeds and onions until golden brown then add ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant
Add chicken mince and cook stirring constantly until it is browned and well separated then add tomatoes and all powdered spices
Add bone-in chicken pieces and a splash of water then simmer covered until both the chicken pieces and mince are cooked through and the gravy is thick

recipes.name: Chicken Kali Mirch
recipes.description: Peppery chicken curry with a sharp black pepper sauce and cumin base

steps.instruction: Coarsely crush black peppercorns and dry-roast with cumin seeds until aromatic then set aside
Brown chicken in ghee then add onions ginger-garlic paste and cook until the onions are deeply golden
Stir in the roasted pepper blend yogurt and tomatoes then simmer covered until the chicken is tender and the sauce is rich and peppery

recipes.name: Chicken Changezi
recipes.description: Mughlai-style creamy chicken in a mildly spiced cashew and milk gravy

steps.instruction: Fry onions in ghee until golden then blend with cashew paste into a smooth creamy base
Sear chicken in ghee with ginger-garlic paste until lightly browned then add the cashew-onion paste and chili powder
Pour in milk and simmer covered until the chicken is tender then finish with cream garam masala and fresh coriander

recipes.name: Chicken Musallam
recipes.description: Whole roasted spiced chicken marinated in yogurt and Mughlai spices

steps.instruction: Score the whole chicken and marinate with yogurt ginger-garlic paste turmeric garam masala and saffron for at least one hour
Sear the chicken in hot ghee in a deep pot until evenly golden on all sides then set aside
Cook fried onions and cashew paste in the same pot add a splash of water then return the chicken and cook covered on low until completely tender then finish with cream

recipes.name: Chicken Mirchi
recipes.description: Fiery chicken curry loaded with green chilies and tempered with cumin and mustard seeds

steps.instruction: Slit green chilies lengthwise and set aside then heat oil and pop cumin and mustard seeds
Sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and turmeric until golden then add tomatoes and coriander powder and cook until thick
Add chicken and the slit green chilies then cook covered until the chicken is tender and the curry is fiery and aromatic

recipes.name: Chicken Chaap
recipes.description: Mughlai-style chicken simmered in a velvety yogurt and cashew gravy with aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Grind fried onions with cashew paste and poppy seeds into a smooth rich paste
Sear chicken in ghee with ginger-garlic paste then add the ground paste yogurt saffron and garam masala and stir well
Simmer covered on low heat until the chicken is very tender and the velvety gravy coats each piece then finish with cream

recipes.name: Mattar Paneer
recipes.description: Creamy curry of paneer cubes and green peas in a spiced onion-tomato gravy

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté cumin seeds onions and ginger-garlic paste until the onions are golden brown
Add tomatoes turmeric and coriander powder then cook until the masala is thick and the oil separates
Add green peas and a little water then simmer until the peas are tender stir in paneer cubes and finish with garam masala

videos.videoTitle: No-Fail! Matar Paneer recipe | माँ की स्पेशल मटर पनीर रेसिपी | Matar Paneer gravy | Chef RanveerBrar

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipes.description: Smoky fire-roasted eggplant mashed and cooked with onions tomatoes and cumin

steps.instruction: Roast whole eggplant over an open flame or under a broiler until the skin is charred and the flesh is completely soft
Peel and mash the roasted eggplant then heat oil and sauté cumin seeds onions ginger garlic and green chilies until golden
Add tomatoes and coriander powder then cook until thick stir in the mashed eggplant and cook for a few minutes until well combined

videos.videoTitle: Best Baingan Ka Bharta Recipe | Quick and Delicious Baingan Ka Bharta Recipe | Eggplant Recipe |

recipes.name: Rajma
recipes.description: Hearty Punjabi kidney bean curry in a thick spiced tomato gravy served over rice

steps.instruction: Soak kidney beans overnight then pressure cook with turmeric until completely soft and tender
Heat oil and pop cumin seeds then sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices until fragrant and oil separates
Add tomatoes and cook until thick then stir in the cooked kidney beans and simmer until the curry is rich and the beans have absorbed the masala

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Punjabi Rajma Recipe | Punjabi Style Rajma | Chef Sanjyot Keer

recipes.name: Avial
recipes.description: Kerala mixed vegetable curry with coconut and yogurt garnished with curry leaves

steps.instruction: Cut all vegetables into long even batons and cook them lightly in a pan with a little water and turmeric until just tender
Grind coconut and cumin seeds into a coarse paste then stir it into the cooked vegetables along with yogurt
Heat coconut oil and temper curry leaves then pour over the avial and gently fold everything together without mashing the vegetables

videos.videoTitle: Avial Recipe | How to make Kerala Aviyal

recipes.name: Kootu
recipes.description: South Indian lentil and vegetable stew tempered with mustard seeds and coconut

steps.instruction: Cook moong dal with turmeric until soft then add cubed vegetables and a little water and cook until just tender
Grind coconut and cumin seeds into a coarse paste and stir it into the dal and vegetable mixture
Heat coconut oil and temper mustard seeds curry leaves and dried red chilies then pour over the kootu and mix gently

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.description: Soft paneer cubes in a velvety tomato-butter sauce with cashew paste and warm spices

steps.instruction: Cook onions tomatoes and cashew paste with a little water until soft then blend into a silky smooth puree
Melt butter in a pan and pour in the puree then add ginger-garlic paste sugar and simmer until the sauce is thick and glossy
Gently slide in paneer cubes and cook for a few minutes until warmed through then stir in cream and garam masala

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.description: Paneer and potato dumplings deep-fried and served in a luscious cashew-cream gravy

steps.instruction: Mash paneer boiled potatoes and corn flour together then shape into smooth round kofta balls and deep-fry until golden
Cook onions tomatoes and cashew paste with a little water until soft then blend into a smooth gravy base
Reheat the gravy in a pan add sugar and garam masala then gently place the kofta balls in and drizzle cream over the top

recipes.name: Dum Aloo
recipes.description: Kashmiri baby potatoes cooked in a fragrant yogurt and spice gravy on dum

steps.instruction: Boil baby potatoes until just tender then peel and lightly prick each one with a fork
Heat ghee and brown the potatoes on all sides then remove and set aside
In the same ghee sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices then whisk in yogurt and cook until smooth return the potatoes and simmer covered on low heat until fully infused

recipes.name: Chole
recipes.description: Bold and tangy Punjabi chickpea curry darkened with tea and loaded with aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Soak chickpeas overnight then pressure cook with tea bags and a little salt until completely soft and darkly stained
Heat oil and pop cumin seeds then sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and chole masala until the masala is thick and fragrant
Add tomatoes and amchur then cook until the gravy is rich stir in the cooked chickpeas and simmer until well combined and deeply spiced

recipes.name: Palak Dal
recipes.description: Nutrient-rich yellow lentils simmered with fresh spinach garlic and a cumin tempering

steps.instruction: Wash and cook toor dal with turmeric until completely soft then mash lightly and set aside
Heat oil and sauté cumin seeds chopped onions tomatoes garlic and green chilies until the onions are golden and tomatoes are soft
Stir in the mashed dal and chopped spinach then simmer until the spinach is wilted and the dal is thick and creamy

recipes.name: Pindi Chana
recipes.description: Dark and tangy chickpea curry from Rawalpindi slow-cooked with whole spices and pomegranate

steps.instruction: Soak chickpeas overnight then pressure cook until completely soft and tender
Heat oil and sauté onions ginger and garlic until golden then add tomatoes cumin powder coriander powder and anardana
Stir in the cooked chickpeas and a little water then simmer on low heat until the gravy is thick and dark then finish with garam masala

recipes.name: Kadhai Paneer
recipes.description: Wok-tossed paneer in a bold tomato gravy with crushed coriander and bell peppers

steps.instruction: Dry-roast crushed coriander seeds and cumin seeds until fragrant then set aside
Heat oil in a kadai and sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and dried red chilies until golden
Add tomatoes bell peppers and the roasted spices then cook on high heat until the vegetables are tender-crisp toss in paneer cubes and cook for two minutes

recipes.name: Tadka Dal
recipes.description: Comforting yellow lentils finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee cumin garlic and chilies

steps.instruction: Wash and cook toor dal with turmeric until completely soft then mash lightly and stir in chopped tomatoes
Prepare the tadka by heating ghee and frying cumin seeds sliced garlic green chilies and dried red chilies until the garlic is golden
Pour the sizzling tadka over the cooked dal then stir in salt and garnish with fresh cilantro

recipes.name: Aloo Matar
recipes.description: Simple and hearty curry of potatoes and green peas in a spiced onion-tomato gravy

steps.instruction: Heat oil and crackle cumin seeds then sauté onions ginger-garlic paste and all powdered spices until fragrant
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down into a thick masala
Stir in cubed potatoes and green peas then add water and simmer covered until the potatoes are tender and the gravy is rich

recipes.name: Kheer
recipes.description: Creamy slow-simmered rice pudding infused with cardamom saffron and crushed pistachios

steps.instruction: Wash and soak rice for thirty minutes then drain and set aside
Bring milk to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pan then add rice and simmer stirring frequently until the rice is very soft and the mixture has thickened
Stir in sugar cardamom saffron and dried fruits then cook for a few more minutes and finish with rose water before serving warm or chilled

videos.videoTitle: Desi Kheer Recipe | Rice Pudding | How to Make Kheer

recipes.name: Jalebi
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried spirals soaked in warm saffron-cardamom sugar syrup

steps.instruction: Mix flour yogurt baking powder and warm water into a smooth batter then let it ferment in a warm place for eight hours
Prepare sugar syrup by boiling sugar water saffron and lemon juice until it reaches a one-string consistency then add cardamom
Pipe the fermented batter in concentric spirals into hot ghee and fry until crisp and golden then immediately dip into the warm sugar syrup

videos.videoTitle: Crispy & Juicy Jalebi Recipe | Perfect Homemade Jalebi Step by Step🔥

recipes.name: Rasgulla
recipes.description: Light and spongy cheese balls simmered in a delicate cardamom sugar syrup

steps.instruction: Bring milk to a boil then add lemon juice to curdle it strain the chenna through muslin cloth and knead until smooth
Mix in semolina and shape the chenna into smooth round balls making sure there are no cracks
Boil sugar and water to make a light syrup then gently drop in the balls and cook covered on low heat for fifteen minutes until they double in size

recipes.name: Barfi
recipes.description: Dense milk fudge set with cardamom and topped with silver leaf and pistachios

steps.instruction: Heat ghee in a heavy pan then add milk powder condensed milk and saffron and stir continuously on low heat
Cook the mixture stirring constantly until it thickens and begins to pull away from the sides of the pan
Transfer to a greased tray and spread evenly then sprinkle cardamom and chopped pistachios on top and press lightly before letting it set

recipes.name: Halwa
recipes.description: Warm semolina pudding roasted in ghee and sweetened with cardamom and nuts

steps.instruction: Roast semolina in ghee over medium heat stirring constantly until it turns golden brown and gives off a nutty aroma
Boil sugar and water separately to make a warm syrup then carefully pour it into the roasted semolina while stirring vigorously
Cook until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides of the pan then stir in cardamom and fried nuts and serve warm

recipes.name: Rasmalai
recipes.description: Soft cheese patties soaked in saffron-cardamom thickened milk and garnished with pistachios

steps.instruction: Bring milk to a boil then add lemon juice to curdle it strain and knead the chenna with semolina until smooth then shape into flat oval patties
Boil sugar water and drop in the patties and cook covered on low heat until they puff up and become spongy then transfer to cold water
Simmer the remaining milk with saffron until it reduces to a thick rabri then add the drained patties and chill before serving with crushed pistachios

recipes.name: Kulfi
recipes.description: Dense Indian ice cream slow-cooked from reduced milk with saffron cardamom and pistachios

steps.instruction: Bring milk to a boil in a heavy pan then reduce heat and simmer stirring frequently until it reduces to about half its original volume
Dissolve corn flour in a little cold milk and stir it into the reduced milk then add sugar saffron and condensed milk and cook until it thickens further
Pour the mixture into kulfi moulds and freeze for at least six hours until set then garnish with crushed pistachios before serving

recipes.name: Payasam
recipes.description: South Indian vermicelli pudding slow-cooked in jaggery milk with ghee-roasted cashews

steps.instruction: Roast vermicelli in a tablespoon of ghee until golden then set aside
Boil milk and dissolve jaggery into it then add the roasted vermicelli and cardamom powder and cook until the vermicelli is soft and the payasam has thickened
Fry cashews raisins and coconut slices in remaining ghee until golden then stir them into the payasam and serve warm

recipes.name: Rogan Josh
recipes.description: Aromatic Kashmiri lamb curry

steps.instruction: Brown lamb pieces.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic paste.
Add Kashmiri chili and yogurt.
Braise lamb in sauce with spices until very tender.

recipes.name: Chicken Korma
recipes.description: Creamy mild chicken curry with almonds

steps.instruction: Fry onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and chicken.
Add yogurt, ground almonds, and spices.
Simmer until tender, finish with cream.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer Paneer
recipes.description: Spinach curry with fresh cheese cubes

steps.instruction: Blanch spinach and blend smooth.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, and cumin.
Add spinach puree and simmer.
Add paneer cubes and cream.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani Creamy
recipes.description: Creamy black lentil curry

steps.instruction: Soak lentils overnight.
Cook until very soft.
Fry onion, garlic, and tomato.
Add to lentils, simmer with cream and butter.
